Definition: Betsalel, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Bezalel means "in the shadow (i.e. protection) of God." The name is shared by several bearers: Son of Uri and grandson of Hur; a skilled Judahite artisan in all works of metal, wood, and stone and one of the architects of the tabernacle; An Israelite, one of the sons of Pahath-moab, in the time of Ezra who had taken a strange wife. It turns up in Exodus 31:2, Exodus 35:30 and Exodus 36:1.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Bezalel is worth remembering, even when little else is told — God counts His people one by one.
